errors.text: The proposed solution omits the key intervention: addition of 4.2 at.% Cr and formation of approximately 4 vol.% Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves phase.

It incorrectly characterizes the baseline as a brittle, continuous-B2 or multiphase alloy with less than 5% ductility and density near 12.5 g/cm³; the target baseline is single-phase BCC, has approximately 11.6% compressive fracture strain, and a density of 10.44 g/cm³.
The predicted density of 10.5-11.5 g/cm³ is not a reduction relative to the actual 10.44 g/cm³ baseline.
The BCC-matrix/B2-precipitate mechanism is extrapolated from an Al-containing alloy without evidence that an analogous B2 phase or order-disorder transition exists in Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr.
The mechanical prediction uses tensile elongation, whereas the target evidence and reported improvements are based on room-temperature compression fracture strain.
